schemas.description:
Input JSON schemas. It should contain the following schema: 
 urn:cisco:codev:identity:idbroker:authnconfig:schemas:1.0

RememberMyLoginId.description: Login Id set to true if it should be remembered.

RememberMyLoginIdDuration.description: Specifies the number of days the user's login ID is remembered. Must be between 1 and 120 (inclusive).
